name: Smashville Detective Agency
source:
Smashville Detective Agency is an anime style story driven mystery visual novel. Control the head of a high school detective agency in a quiet mountain town, where a mysterious murder has occurred. You will meet various interesting and wacky characters, and you travel to intriguing and aesthetically pleasing destinations as you piece together the clues to this murder mystery. Interrogations, gathering clues, and ultimately putting everything together to solve the case!

Something is afoot as a student at Smashville High School has been murdered! Can Spike, Mandy, and Devin follow the trail to figure out why people are acting sketchy in Smashville. This game features a custom soundtrack produced by the one and only DJ Dino Head!
translation:
《Smashville Detective Agency》是一款动漫风格的剧情向悬疑推理视觉小说。你将扮演宁静山间小镇上一所高中侦探社的社长，调查当地发生的一起离奇命案。在拼凑这桩杀人谜案线索的过程中，你将结识形形色色有趣又古怪的角色，并造访充满魅力与美感的各个地点。审问证人、搜集线索，最终将一切串联起来侦破案件！

斯马什维尔高中一名学生惨遭杀害，暗流正在悄然涌动！斯派克、曼迪与德文能否顺藤摸瓜，查明斯马什维尔镇上的人们为何举止鬼祟？本作还配有由独一无二的DJ Dino Head倾力打造的原创配乐！
